# Cncf Viettel Ai Platform Reviewer

Review Viettel AI Platform using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Distribution category. Viettel AI Platform is a container management and orchestration platform based on Cloud Native architecture, designed to support AI/ML applications running in Kubernetes environments.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
